item.title: insomniac 0.1.0
item.description: First Windows release. insomniac keeps you active in presence-aware apps like Teams, Slack and Zoom by resetting the system idle timer with an invisible key event, and can also keep the display and system awake. Per-user install, no admin rights. v0.1 is not code-signed: SmartScreen will warn - choose "More info", then "Run anyway".
